title: EIGHT THOUSAND YEARS OVERDUE // THE LATE FEE
narrative: The Night King stands before the Wall holding an ancient frosted parchment stamped with the Citadel's iron seal. He points at the title: 'A Natural History of Giant Mammoths, by Archmaester Gallard — DUE DATE: 8,000 BC.' He holds out forty copper pennies in his frostbitten gauntlet. 'We didn't want to destroy the world of men,' he hisses in crackling ice syllables. 'We just wanted to return the book, but the maesters charge one silver groat per century in late fines. We owe four million gold dragons.'
resolvesPlotHole: The Others Invade Solely to Return a Library Scroll

options.text: Waive the late fee and negotiate an ice-and-steel duel.
Search the Citadel forbidden vaults to see if the library card is valid.
Challenge the Others to settle the fine in an ice hockey match.
